patch.objective: Disaster recovery concepts: RPO, RTO, MTTR, MTBF, and site types

sources.cite: CompTIA Network+ N10-009 Exam Objectives, Version 4.0: Networking concepts 23%, Network implementation 20%, Network operations 19%, Network security 14%, Network troubleshooting 24%
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-16 of a copy of CompTIA's objectives PDF hosted by a training provider. Relevant text: 3.1 'Explain the purpose of organizational processes and procedures' (change management); 3.3 'Explain disaster recovery (DR) concepts' (RPO, RTO, cold, warm and hot sites); 3.4 'Given a scenario, implement IPv4 and IPv6 network services'; 4.2 'Summarize various types of attacks and their impact to the network' (ARP poisoning, ARP spoofing, on-path attack; rogue devices and services: DHCP). The objective wording here is the course seed's.

Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch. Relevant text: 'Maintain offline, encrypted backups of critical data, and regularly test the availability and integrity of backups'; 'Some cloud vendors offer immutable storage solutions that can protect stored data'; 'Determine which systems were impacted, and immediately isolate them'; 'If several systems or subnets appear impacted, take the network offline at the switch level.'

sources.cite: NIST SP 800-34 Rev. 1, Contingency Planning Guide for Federal Information Systems (May 2010, updated November 11, 2010)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-14 through a summarizing fetch of the CSRC page: final, not withdrawn. Its abstract says it helps 'determine contingency planning requirements and priorities'; the BIA, RTO, RPO and alternate-site terms used here are the guide's vocabulary and were not re-read in the PDF. The tier table is the author's.
